species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
South wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
